build_from_dump: build train, valid, and test dialogue datasets from a directory of JSON chat dump files
read_dump: read a single JSON chat dump file and convert its header-row format into a list of chat dicts
read_dumps: read and format all JSON chat dump files from a directory into a unified chat list
filter_chats: filter a list of chats to keep only non-empty dialogues or only flagged messages
filter_by_model: filter a list of chats to keep only those generated by a specific hobbot model name
format_chats: format a raw chat list into the standard schema based on the data collection date
